items.title: Minneapolis Glass Breaks Ground on New Brooklyn Park Headquarters
items.description: The woman-owned manufacturing firm Minneapolis Glass hosted a groundbreaking ceremony at its new Brooklyn Park headquarters this week.  Located near Highways 610 and 169, the larger facility will allow the company to expand its capacity. Despite growth, the business maintains many close family ties.
